summary: Engagement is weakest on Bluesky (zero likes/comments) and overall Instagram reels have high skip rates; bio also narrows niche and promises a free check, which breaches brand rules.
guidance:
- High skip rates (63‑77%) show the first 3 seconds lose viewers; start with bold visual or text that promises a concrete benefit.
- Reels get few comments/shares; add a clear DM call‑to‑action and ask a question to spark replies.
- Rotate hook styles: try "Story" or "Contrast" after the recent "Question" and "Myth‑Bust" to keep content fresh.
- Avoid repeating the same phrasing (e.g., "same five questions") across posts.
- Keep tone that you’re a developer showing real work, not an ad; use generic mockups, not client claims.
- Use a mix of feed (image) and reels; feed posts currently get lower reach.

instructions.research: Identify two hook styles (e.g., Story, Contrast) that performed well for similar small‑business accounts this week.
instructions.analysis: Review the 44‑second presenter reel (highest avg watch) to note which visual or audio element kept viewers past the first 5 seconds.
instructions.writer: Draft a website post titled "The Missing Website Trust Gap" with three quick fixes and a DM CTA; no guarantees, no free audit outside the post.
instructions.image: Create a generic website screenshot (no branding) with overlay text highlighting the three fixes.
instructions.video: Produce a 15‑second reel: first 3 seconds show bold text "No website? Trust drops 40%" then a fast cut to the 3 fixes and end with "DM for a free 3‑point look".

manual_tips: Comment thoughtfully on at least five posts from local businesses across different Indian cities to increase visibility.
Respond promptly to any DMs received today, offering honest advice and the "pay after approval" option.
Edit the Instagram bio to remove specific industries, region, and the free‑check promise; keep it generic and compliant.

weak_signals.detail: the last 3 settled posts got zero likes, comments, shares and saves
